newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain reduces number of income tax thresholds.
newsitem.headline: Spain reduces number of income tax thresholds.

text.p: The Spanish cabinet approved on Friday the reduction of the number of income tax brackets to 10, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said.
Currently, there are 18 thresholds for individual tax returns, and 17 for joint filings.
According to tax secretary Juan Costa, the rate on the new brackets runs from 17 to 47.6 percent paid to the central government, plus a range of three to 8.4 percent to certain regional governments.
